children: The Czech Finance Ministry will offer 16 billion crowns  ($754.72 million) worth of domestic government bonds in auctions in October, it said on Monday.
The ministry said the maximum expected nominal value of bonds sold in auctions in the fourth quarter was planned at up to 50 billion crowns.
The ministry added it would also offer up to 10 billion crowns worth of short-term Treasury bills, as well as 250 million to 500 million euros of euro-denominated bills.
